newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aerospatiale hopes for merger by June 97.
newsitem.headline: Aerospatiale hopes for merger by June 97.

text.p: PARIS, Sept 19 (reuter) - Aerospatiale chairman Yves Michot said in a newspaper interview on Thursday he hoped a planned merger with Dassault Aviation should be wrapped up by June of next year.
"If we can wrap it up for the Paris Le Bourget airshow, that would be perfect," he said in an interview published in daily Le Figaro.

The blueprint for the merger to be spelled out at the end of December will cover the capital structure, the legal framework of the operation and the organisational structure of the merged entity, he said.

Michot said he hoped that Airbus Industrie European aircraft consortium would be converted into a limited company by the end of 1999. Airbus groups Aerospatiale, DASA, British Aerospace and Spain's CASA.
